supply_voltage: powered from its own USB cable; only GND is shared with the probe cube
data: Streams $NAUT,T=<degC>,H=<%RH>,SEQ=<n>* frames at 1 Hz from power-up (period set by RATE). T drifts 21-27 degC, H drifts 47-63 %RH. SEQ increments by 1 per frame.

test_plan.name: stream
test_plan.instruction: Leave both boards powered and the jumper wires in place while the stream is measured.
test_plan.expect: At least 10 samples at 250 ms. T between 20 and 28, H between 45 and 65. seq_gaps 0 and no garbled_lines.

test_plan.name: link_clean
test_plan.instruction: Keep the wires still while the link error counters are measured.
test_plan.expect: link rx > 0 and link ORE, FE, NE and PE all 0.
